                    if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best is not None and (i, j, len(merged_route)) < best[:3]):
                        best_gain = gain
                        best = (i, j, len(merged_route), merged_route)
                    elif best is None and gain > 0:
                        best_gain = gain
                        best = (i, j, len(merged_route), merged_route)
        if best is not None and best_gain > 0:
            i, j, _, merged_route = best
            routes[i] = merged_route
            routes.pop(j)
            loads[i] = rload(merged_route)
            loads.pop(j)
            merged = True

    # Repair: relocate single customers if it improves total cost.
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        loads = [rload(r) for r in routes]
        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            for idx, node in enumerate(ra):
                prev = depot if idx == 0 else ra[idx - 1]
                nxt = depot if idx == len(ra) - 1 else ra[idx + 1]
                remove_delta = D[prev][nxt] - D[prev][node] - D[node][nxt]
                for b in range(len(routes)):
                    if a == b:
                        continue
                    if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    pos, ins_delta = best_insert_pos(routes[b], node)
                    delta = remove_delta + ins_delta
                    if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_move is not None and (a, b, idx, pos) < best_move[:4]):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_move = (a, b, idx, pos, node)
        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            a, b, idx, pos, node = best_move
            if a < b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                changed = True
            else:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                changed = True

    # Intra-route 2-opt with depot endpoints.
    for ridx in range(len(routes)):
        route = routes[ridx]
        if len(route) < 4:
            continue
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            nrt = len(route)
            for i in range(nrt - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for k in range(i + 2, nrt):
                    c = route[k]
                    d = depot if k == nrt - 1 else route[k + 1]
                    old = D[a][b] + D[c][d]
                    new = D[a][c] + D[b][d]
                    if new < old:
                        route[i:k + 1] = route[i:k + 1][::-1]
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break

    # Final route cleanup and deterministic ordering.
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    routes.sort(key=lambda r: (r[0], len(r), rcost(r)))

    return routes
